prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Potassium (K) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a training gym with a heavy bag, ring ropes, a fencing strip and racks of weights
Outfit: a fitted archery top with an arm guard — in a clear pattern such as a floral print, bold stripes, gingham or plaid, in two or three cheerful colours; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; right now — one strap — or one side of the neckline — has slipped down off her shoulder, baring that whole shoulder and the top of her arm; she leaves it as it is, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she dries her hair with a towel — her own right hand presses the towel to the top of her head, her own left hand holds the towel at the side of her hair.
LEGS: weight even on both legs.
EXPRESSION: softened eyes, faint sad smile, inner brows raised.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — potassium: a soft silver-white metal that cuts like cold butter and must sleep under oil; dropped in water it skates and bursts into lilac flame, wilder than sodium; named for potash, the ash of burned wood leached in iron pots; the first metal pulled out by electric current, by Humphry Davy in 1807; its ions carry every nerve signal and keep the heart beating; potash feeds the fields and saltpetre feeds gunpowder — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
